article.title: -게 하다 causativa
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태

claims.summary: The NIKL grammar description analyzes **-게 하다** as a causative/permissive construction in which a subject causes or allows a target to perform an action. It documents alternative case marking for the target (e.g., **아이가/아이를/아이에게** with **앉게 하다**); this entry is limited to those patterns and does not treat one marker as obligatory in every context.
